I've had a good look at the working app, and yes — I accept it as the completed first cycle.

Everything I care about from what we settled is right there in front of me: the paste-and-save box at the top, my collection sitting beneath it, the search bar that clearly knows about labels with `#`, phrases, and the and/or/not combining we worked out, the label filter row, and the To read / Done tabs each showing their count. Starting me off with a clean, empty collection is exactly right for a brand-new personal home — and even empty it's reassuring rather than blank, with the "No To read bookmarks" note pointing me at how to begin. I opened the edit panel too and it's got all the fields we agreed on: title, description, web address, note, and labels.

It matches the behavior we approved together across all those flows — saving with page details and a preserved copy, duplicate handling, the powerful search, moving things between To read and Done, editing, and all the careful recovery when something goes wrong. You've told me your checks and tests all pass and the dependency audit came back clean, and nothing I'm seeing contradicts that.

Just so it's on record for down the road: accepting this is accepting the first version we scoped, not a claim that it does absolutely everything I'll ever dream up. As I mentioned, once I'm living in it day to day I'll probably come back with a few ordinary extras — but those are for a future round and none of them hold up accepting this. It's a genuinely solid, trustworthy first version and I'm happy with it. Thank you.
